Ollie & Bollie: Outdoor Estate

A downloadable game for Windows and macOS

Get this game and 7 more for $18.00 USD
Sokpop Season #6
View bundle
Buy Now$3.00 USD or more

A cute sandbox game about restoring an estate.

Work with your (real or AI) friend Bollie to cut trees, catch sheep, build a shed and more in this outdoor autumn sandbox game. 

  • four tasks to complete
  • 2 player local co-op
  • gamepad support
  • freerunning
  • really good Bollie AI

Co-op

To play co-op, set Bollie to p2 in the options menu. Controls:

Ollie: arrow keys + ,  and .
Bollie: WASD + N and M
You can also play with either one or two controllers!

Originally made as a Humble Original for the October 2018 Humble Monthly

also made for the Sokpop Patreon

Sarla5 years ago (1 edit) (+1)

Some of the game mechanics are a little bit broken and the Bollie AI can be really annoying and a bit broken sometimes (but it can be disabled easily). 

However the art, simple but still just challenging enough "quests", and peaceful atmosphere of the game definitely make up for any trouble I had. It sometimes makes you think, but it doesn't stress you out if you can't figure something out.

Definitely worth $3 (probably more than that IMO) so I definitely recommend it even though it's a short game.
